text:
maria: FYI during the eu1 TLS rekey maintenance we observed SSE sessions that stayed TCP-connected but stopped receiving event frames for ~30-90s, then resumed. console showed no socket close.

sam: do we have a trace id or example?

maria: trace 4c9b2e, console span: https://console/redwood/trace/4c9b2e. ops-bot fired sse.no-output alerts. last-event-id kept incrementing on the server side but clients got no data.

jonathan: my suspicion: our keepalive-squelch rollout suppressed pings during rekey windows to reduce fanout noise. clients have a reconnect debounce and therefore never reopened, resulting in a silent stall rather than an explicit reconnect.

lee: can you paste the raw request we used to repro? we should rule out proxy half-close.

maria: repro curl (intermittent):

```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-xxx" \
  --max-time 120
```

When rekey hits, TCP stays established (no FIN/RST) but no SSE frames for ~45s, then stream resumes mid-response. Chat UIs often show spinner and are not surfacing resumed tokens.

ops-bot: ALERT sse.no-output spike -> 128 events in 8m (eu1). top tenants: acct-42, acct-77.

sam: metrics show `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` spikes coincide with `proxy.tls_rekey_count`. sampling low; increasing traces now.

jonathan: product: is resume-with-gap acceptable? we avoided forced reconnects to prevent duplicate billing and replaying tokens. But UX for interactive apps is impacted.

maria: product says graceful resume is fine in general, but for chat UIs gaps are problematic; they want resumed chunks to surface instead of indefinite spinner.

lee: short-term ops mitigation: reduce squelch threshold in eu1 (0.75 -> 0.5) to lower suppression during rekeys. ops can flip the flag.

sam: I'll create a canary flag and add a console banner. bumping tracing sample to 10% for 2 hours to gather more slices.

jonathan: proposed engineering changes: 1) runtime: emit `x-rekey-hint: 1` header during rekey windows so clients can treat stalls specially; 2) client: implement a small stall-to-reconnect heuristic (if no frames >10s and `x-rekey-hint` present, attempt resume); 3) telemetry: add route/tenant/model labels to keepalive metrics and a `sse.stall_duration_seconds` histogram; 4) ops: temporary squelch rollback.

maria: created runbook RB-2219, owners: maria (investigate), sam (flags/telemetry), jonathan (runtime header), lee (ops). target hotfix today, full fix in next release.

lee: ops note: we'll roll back and monitor for side effects. sam, post trace slices and alert suppression plan to RB-2219.

sam: will do. updating console dashboards to show suppression labeled by tenant so CS can triage quickly.

maria: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and customer note for affected tenants. :thumbsup:
